subject.title: Fix dashboard chat run recovery across reconnects

question: Should maintainers adopt or rewrite this stale branch on current main, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or keep it paused until a replacement PR owns the paired Dashboard busy-state issue?
rationale: The PR addresses a real linked bug, but it crosses stale protocol, shutdown, and session-state behavior where automation should not choose the permanent repair shape or proof waiver.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the recovery intent while using current filtered active-run, protocol-package, and restart-drain contracts.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The contributor can update the branch against current main and add redacted live Dashboard proof before another merge review.

options.title: Pause until replacement is viable
options.body: If a newer proof-positive PR becomes the safe fix path for the paired issue, this branch can be closed as superseded then.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the recovery intent while using current filtered active-run, protocol-package, and restart-drain contracts.
